Use the helper `powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "<this skill's folder>\scripts\log.ps1" -LogFile <logfile> -Phase <phase> -Decision <decision> -Why <why> -Evidence <evidence> -Result <result>`. It stamps `ts`, writes the header on first use, strips stray tabs and line breaks, and prefixes any cell starting with `=`, `+`, `-`, or `@` with a single quote. Bind a value that itself starts with `-` with a colon, as in `-Evidence:'-12%'`. Appending a row by hand works too, but write UTF-8 without a byte order mark, and mind those same characters if cells come from generated or user-supplied text.
